form.why: Codi r45b: no default day on the checkout form. startDay returns the ?day the link named or null, never showDays[0]. Continue to payment stays an enabled submit button; with a day product and no day it shows the r45 error (TICKET_COPY.chooseDay under the "Choose a day" legend, the TicketFormField alert class plus mt-1.5, aria-invalid on the fieldset) and focuses the first enabled radio of the group, the same focus target as the hub card (F1), before the quantity hint, attendee validation or any request. With ?day the day is pre-selected as before.

page.why: Without ?day the summary TicketCard gets day null, so (F1's `day ? showDayStub(day) : null`) its stub is TICKET_PRODUCTS.day's own '' / '' and its when line is TICKET_PRODUCTS.day.when, "Friday, Saturday or Sunday": no date. A day picked in the form still reaches it through CHECKOUT_DAY_EVENT.
